asked.item: Dental brand channel missing from the YouTube connect list
What to do to connect it

verdict.reason: The help pages say a channel may not appear when you only have the Manager role, and they give the fix.

steps.text: If you are listed only as a Manager, the channel may not appear when connecting.
Ask the current Owner to make you an Owner of the channel (or transfer ownership to you), then reconnect.
For a branded or managed channel, select the channel from your main Google account before connecting.
